Original diagrams & decorative artwork

The four model diagrams are original explanatory SVG drawings prepared with AI assistance, based on these sources. They are not reproduced figures or measured model activations.

AI-generated decorative icons

The ten pros/cons icons were generated using OpenAI’s image-generation tool for this poster. They illustrate concepts and are not source evidence, photographs or figures from the cited papers. No model version is asserted where the generation record does not name one.

The film strip, clapperboard and paper texture are decorative HTML/SVG artwork.
